prompt:
Production sprite sheet for the SECOND episode of the referenced original Chinese university campus cat story. Reuse the two exact people from the bottom-right reference: young adult Chinese college boy short messy black hair, faded dusty blue scarf, charcoal small backpack, white top and thin dark legs; girl black ponytail, warm cream long sleeve top and black skirt. Match the existing fine, slightly irregular black pen linework, slim B1 stick-limb proportions, small hands, restricted warm neutral colors, simple but very readable poses. Use pure plain white background (#FFFFFF), free of shadows, ground marks, paper textures, letters, panel borders, furniture, environment and any cat.
Four isolated illustrations centered in an exact 2 by 2 simple grid, each fully contained within a quadrant with generous white margins and wide empty gutters. Top LEFT: only the girl, standing facing screen left in three-quarter view with a relaxed smile, lifting one open hand in a familiar wave, other hand holds a small dark smartphone at hip, show whole body. Top RIGHT: only the same girl, crouching at camera-left side of an imaginary cat and facing screen RIGHT, holding a dark smartphone vertically with both hands, aiming it down and right to photograph a cat; screen faces her and remains invisible to audience, focus on the hands, entire figure from hair to shoes. Bottom LEFT: only the same boy in three-quarter view facing right, sitting on an imaginary bench with body clearly seated, legs bent naturally, both hands holding an open small ivory paperback, looking down and reading. His gray backpack still visible; no bench, render entire person. Bottom RIGHT: only the same boy, facing right, rising from the imaginary bench with slight forward lean, open ivory paperback in his left hand and right hand extended forward and down to pick up an imaginary phone, quick surprised smile, full body. Keep character appearances and pen style identical in all poses. No extra human, no icons, no words, no colored borders. Wide 3:2.
